subskills.label: Apply Kaizen and Kaizen-blitz concepts to a bounded improvement need
subskills.capability_statement: Given a bounded improvement opportunity and stated constraints, distinguish continuous Kaizen from a focused Kaizen-blitz approach, identify an evidence-bounded event or improvement structure, and keep actual adoption and realized results unobserved until evidenced.

decomposition_edges.rationale: Make Kaizen/Kaizen-blitz application independently assessable while preserving implementation adoption and realized outcomes as external evidence.

unresolved_dependency_candidates.reason: Waste-elimination reasoning may inform Kaizen activity selection, but the frozen source identities do not establish a mandatory curriculum prerequisite.
Cycle-time reduction may be pursued through Kaizen, but topic relationship alone is insufficient for canonical hard-prerequisite admission.
